item.description:
Release v5.7.2

Changes since v5.7.1

  • feat(ChatPanelPlugin): declare supportsProject for chat container
  • feat(ConversationAgentTurnCountPlugin): replace tooltip with clickable button and popover detail panel
  • feat(DeviceInfoPlugin): declare supportsProject for device info container
  • feat(EditorPanelPlugin): declare supportsProject for editor container
  • feat(kernel): add httpStatusCode and httpBody to LumiChatMessage
  • feat(kernel): add lumiConversationDidDelete notification
  • feat(kernel): add lumiConversationWillDelete notification
  • feat(kernel): add supportsProject property to ViewContainerItem
  • feat(LLMKit): preserve HTTP status code and body in error messages
  • feat(LLMProviderAliyunPlugin): register provider render kind prefix on boot
  • feat(LLMProviderManagerPlugin): add API key diagnostic view for missing key errors
  • feat(LLMProviderXiaomiPlugin): register provider render kind prefix on boot
  • feat(LLMProviderZhipuPlugin): register provider render kind prefix on boot
  • feat(LumiKernel): add API key diagnostic for LLM providers
  • feat(LumiKernel): add requiresProjectSupport flag to hide rail tabs when no project is open
  • feat(MessageListPlugin): gate renderer id badge behind #if DEBUG
  • feat(MessageListPlugin): overlay renderer id badge in MessageRowView
  • feat(MessageManagerPlugin): add httpStatusCode and httpBody to MessageModel
  • feat(MessageRendererPlugin): display HTTP status code and body in error view
  • feat(OpenInVSCodePlugin): add Open in VSCode plugin
